summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with abdominal pain, nausea, and uncontrolled type 1 diabetes that presented with diabetic ketoacidosis. She had a history of chronic pancreatitis and a temporary pancreatic stent placed after a prior ERCP. During this admission, she underwent successful removal of the pancreatic stent via EGD. Her DKA resolved with IV fluids and insulin, and she transitioned to subcutaneous insulin with instructions to titrate based on appetite and glucose monitoring. She tolerated oral intake, her pain remained consistent with her baseline chronic pattern, and she was discharged home in stable condition with ongoing management of her chronic conditions.
